    axis0loc = xr.DataArray(
        _arc_lat_wgs84(lat2d),
        coords=data.coords,

    )

        _arc_lon_wgs84(lon2d, lat2d),
        coords=data.coords,
        dims=data.dims,
    )

    axis0dist = xr.DataArray(

    grad = xr.DataArray(
        np.gradient(data),
        dims=('dir',) + data.dims,
    )
    axis0grad = grad[0] / axis0dist
    axis1grad = grad[1] / axis1dist

    return [axis0grad, axis1grad]
```
